purpose: The totals or summary row at the bottom of a Table, on Surface/muted with a hairline above.

Default.visual: Fill Surface/muted; a top hairline in Border/subtle (Stroke/divider); the values are TableCell in Type/label.

a11y.keyboard: No keys of its own; not focusable.
notes: Label the totals with a th scope="row" in the first cell; set it sticky in code to pin it.
